#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Receive and use a complete original finalized SF100 room.
require "optparse"
require_relative(File.file?(File.join(__dir__,"native_dataset_receiving.rb")) ?
  "native_dataset_receiving" : "../native_dataset_receiving")

module Starforge
  module NativeDatasetCommand
    module_function
    def open_delivery(options)
      if options[:directory]
        Files.need(!options[:delivery] && !options[:manifest], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_ONE_SELECTION")
        NativeDatasetReceiving.received(directory: options[:directory])
      else
        Files.need(options[:delivery] && options[:manifest], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_DELIVERY_REQUIRED")
        delivery = DatasetDelivery.open(options[:delivery],expected_manifest_sha256: options[:manifest])
        Files.need(delivery.is_a?(NativeDatasetDelivery), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_DELIVERY_REQUIRED")
        delivery
      end
    end

    def summary(delivery)
      {"schema"=>NativeDatasetReceiving::RESULT_SCHEMA,"state"=>"RECEIVED",
        "directory"=>delivery.directory,"manifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256,
        "sourceFormat"=>delivery.source_format,"sourceId"=>delivery.source_sha256,
        "datasetId"=>delivery.manifest["datasetId"],"sourceKey"=>delivery.manifest["sourceKey"],
        "snapshot"=>delivery.snapshot,"rowCount"=>delivery.row_count,"fields"=>delivery.fields,
        "membership"=>delivery.membership,"nativeSourceBindingSha256"=>delivery.manifest["sourceBindingSha256"],
        "nativeReceiptSha256"=>delivery.descriptor("native-receiving.json")["sha256"],
        "columns"=>delivery.native_receipt["columns"],
        "semantics"=>delivery.native_manifest["semantics"],"files"=>delivery.manifest["files"]}
    end

    def export_file(delivery, name, path)
      expected = delivery.descriptor(name)
      path = File.expand_path(path)
      parent = Files.directory(File.dirname(path))
      Files.need(path != File.join(delivery.directory,name), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_EXPORT_DESTINATION_REQUIRED")
      temp = Tempfile.new([".native-dataset-export-", ".pending"],parent)
      begin
        temp.binmode
        delivery.each_chunk(name) { |bytes| temp.write(bytes) }
        temp.flush
        temp.fsync
        temp.close
        begin
          File.link(temp.path,path)
          Files.sync(parent)
        rescue Errno::EEXIST
          DatasetDelivery.snapshot_file(path,expected) { |_snapshot| }
        end
        {"path"=>path,"name"=>name,"bytes"=>expected["bytes"],"sha256"=>expected["sha256"],
          "manifestSha256"=>delivery.manifest_sha256}
      ensure
        temp.close!
      end
    end

    def main(argv)
      command = argv.shift
      options = {}
      parser = OptionParser.new do |o|
        o.banner = "ruby native_dataset_customer.rb COMMAND [options]"
        o.separator "receive --directory DIR --room ORIGINAL_ROOM --source-key KEY --dataset-id ID --native-manifest-sha256 SHA --checkout SOURCE --python ABS --node ABS"
        o.separator "resume|status --directory ORIGINAL_RECEIVING"
        o.separator "inspect|rows|copy|file --directory ORIGINAL_RECEIVING"
        o.separator "inspect|rows|copy|file --delivery COMPLETE_PACKET --manifest-sha256 SHA"
        o.separator "copy adds --out DIRECTORY; file adds --file ORIGINAL_NAME --out NEW_FILE"
        o.on("--directory DIRECTORY") { |v| options[:directory] = v }
        o.on("--room DIRECTORY") { |v| options[:room] = v }
        o.on("--source-key KEY") { |v| options[:source_key] = v }
        o.on("--dataset-id ID") { |v| options[:dataset_id] = v }
        o.on("--native-manifest-sha256 SHA") { |v| options[:native_manifest] = v }
        o.on("--checkout DIRECTORY") { |v| options[:checkout] = v }
        o.on("--python ABSOLUTE_PATH") { |v| options[:python] = v }
        o.on("--node ABSOLUTE_PATH") { |v| options[:node] = v }
        o.on("--delivery DIRECTORY") { |v| options[:delivery] = v }
        o.on("--manifest-sha256 SHA") { |v| options[:manifest] = v }
        o.on("--file NAME") { |v| options[:file] = v }
        o.on("--out PATH") { |v| options[:out] = v }
        o.on("--timeout SECONDS",Integer) { |v| options[:timeout] = v }
        o.on("-h","--help") { puts o; return 0 }
      end
      if command.nil? || %w[-h --help].include?(command)
        puts parser
        return 0
      end
      parser.parse!(argv)
      Files.need(argv.empty? && %w[receive resume status inspect rows copy file].include?(command),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMMAND_INVALID")
      selection_keys = %i[directory delivery manifest]
      allowed = case command
      when "receive" then %i[directory room source_key dataset_id native_manifest checkout python node timeout]
      when "resume" then %i[directory timeout]
      when "status" then [:directory]
      when "inspect","rows" then selection_keys
      when "copy" then selection_keys+[:out]
      when "file" then selection_keys+%i[file out]
      end
      Files.need((options.keys-allowed).empty?, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMMAND_OPTIONS_INVALID")
      interrupted = false
      cancellation = Object.new
      cancellation.define_singleton_method(:cancelled?) { interrupted }
      old_int = Signal.trap("INT") { interrupted = true }
      old_term = Signal.trap("TERM") { interrupted = true }
      begin
        result = case command
        when "receive"
          required = %i[directory room source_key dataset_id native_manifest checkout python node]
          Files.need(required.all? { |key| options[key] }, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
          receiver = NativeDatasetReceiving.new(directory: options[:directory],room: options[:room],
            source_key: options[:source_key],dataset_id: options[:dataset_id],
            expected_native_manifest_sha256: options[:native_manifest],checkout: options[:checkout],
            python: options[:python],node: options[:node])
          summary(receiver.receive(cancel: cancellation,timeout: options.fetch(:timeout,1800)))
        when "resume"
          Files.need(options[:directory], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
          summary(NativeDatasetReceiving.resume(directory: options[:directory],
            cancel: cancellation,timeout: options.fetch(:timeout,1800)))
        when "status"
          Files.need(options[:directory], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
          NativeDatasetReceiving.status(directory: options[:directory])
        else
          delivery = open_delivery(options)
          case command
          when "inspect" then summary(delivery)
          when "rows"
            $stdout.binmode
            delivery.each_chunk("dataset.jsonl") { |bytes| $stdout.write(bytes) }
            return 0
          when "copy"
            Files.need(options[:out], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_EXPORT_DESTINATION_REQUIRED")
            summary(delivery.copy_to(options[:out]))
          when "file"
            Files.need(options[:file] && options[:out], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_EXPORT_SELECTION_REQUIRED")
            export_file(delivery,options[:file],options[:out])
          end
        end
        $stdout.write(Files.json(result))
        0
      ensure
        Signal.trap("INT",old_int)
        Signal.trap("TERM",old_term)
      end
    rescue Error, OptionParser::ParseError, SystemCallError => error
      code = error.respond_to?(:code) ? error.code : error.is_a?(OptionParser::ParseError) ?
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMMAND_INVALID" : "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_FILE_UNAVAILABLE"
      $stderr.write(JSON.generate({"error"=>code})+"\n")
      2
    end
  end
end
exit Starforge::NativeDatasetCommand.main(ARGV.dup) if File.expand_path($PROGRAM_NAME) == File.expand_path(__FILE__)

// MIT. Original native SDK version shared without initializing the native factory.
export const NATIVE_SDK_VERSION = '2.28.0';

// MIT. One fixed Redis/Valkey EVAL_RO script. Buyers supply typed values, never code.
// Projection and byte accounting happen before any database value crosses the wire.
export const READ_SCRIPT = `
local kind, count, budget, position = ARGV[1], tonumber(ARGV[2]), tonumber(ARGV[3]), ARGV[4]
local rows, used, truncated = {}, 0, 0
local function keep(value)
  if type(value) == 'string' then
    used = used + string.len(value)
    if used > budget then error('SF30_RESULT_TOO_LARGE') end
  end
  return value
end
if kind == 'get' then
  if redis.call('STRLEN', KEYS[1]) > budget then error('SF30_RESULT_TOO_LARGE') end
  rows[1] = {keep(redis.call('GET', KEYS[1]))}
elseif kind == 'hash' then
  local size, fields = 0, {}
  for i = 5, #ARGV do
    size = size + redis.call('HSTRLEN', KEYS[1], ARGV[i])
    if size > budget then error('SF30_RESULT_TOO_LARGE') end
    fields[#fields + 1] = ARGV[i]
  end
  local values = redis.call('HMGET', KEYS[1], unpack(fields))
  for i = 1, #values do keep(values[i]) end
  rows[1] = values
elseif kind == 'list' then
  local start = tonumber(position)
  local values = redis.call('LRANGE', KEYS[1], position, tostring(start + count - 1))
  for i = 1, #values do rows[#rows + 1] = {tostring(start + i - 1), keep(values[i])} end
  if redis.call('LLEN', KEYS[1]) > start + #values then truncated = 1 end
elseif kind == 'set' then
  -- COUNT is a work hint, not a row limit. Return a whole native batch or fail:
  -- slicing it while advancing the native cursor would silently skip members.
  local page = redis.call('SSCAN', KEYS[1], position, 'COUNT', ARGV[5])
  if #page[2] > count then error('SF30_SCAN_PAGE_TOO_MANY_ROWS') end
  for i = 1, #page[2] do rows[#rows + 1] = {keep(page[2][i])} end
  if page[1] ~= '0' then truncated = 1 end
  return {truncated, rows, page[1]}
elseif kind == 'sorted-set' then
  local start = tonumber(position)
  for offset = start, start + count do
    local pair = redis.call('ZRANGE', KEYS[1], tostring(offset), tostring(offset), 'WITHSCORES')
    if #pair == 0 then break end
    if offset == start + count then truncated = 1; break end
    rows[#rows + 1] = {keep(pair[1]), keep(pair[2])}
  end
elseif kind == 'stream' then
  local cursor = position == '-' and '-' or '(' .. position
  for i = 1, count + 1 do
    local entries = redis.call('XRANGE', KEYS[1], cursor, '+', 'COUNT', 1)
    if #entries == 0 then break end
    if i > count then truncated = 1; break end
    local entry, selected = entries[1], {}
    for j = 1, #entry[2], 2 do selected[entry[2][j]] = entry[2][j + 1] end
    local row = {keep(entry[1])}
    for j = 5, #ARGV do row[#row + 1] = keep(selected[ARGV[j]] or false) end
    rows[#rows + 1] = row
    cursor = '(' .. entry[1]
  end
else error('SF30_QUERY_KIND_INVALID') end
return {truncated, rows}
`;

# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Durable business-job receiving over the original seller and Node Buyer.
require_relative "seller_client"

module Starforge
  # Keep the key in your application's job/database record. The same key selects
  # one native intent across Active Job retries and process restarts.
  class Receiving
    attr_reader :directory, :intent_id
    def self.key_id(key)
      Files.need(key.is_a?(String) && !key.strip.empty? && key.bytesize <= 1024 &&
        key.valid_encoding?, "RUBY_BUSINESS_KEY_REQUIRED")
      Files.hash(key.b)
    end
    def self.intent_id(key)
      "ruby:" + key_id(key)
    end
    def self.received(directory:, key:, expected_manifest_sha256: nil)
      root = Files.directory(directory)
      path = Files.directory(File.join(root,key_id(key)))
      job_bytes = Files.read(File.join(path,"job.json"),131_072)
      job = Files.parse(job_bytes)
      receipt = Files.parse(Files.read(File.join(path,"received.json"),131_072))
      Files.need(job["schema"] == "stellar-forge.ruby-business-job.v1" &&
        job["keySha256"] == key_id(key) && job["intentId"] == intent_id(key) &&
        receipt["schema"] == "stellar-forge.ruby-business-received.v1" &&
        receipt["jobSha256"] == Files.hash(job_bytes) &&
        receipt["intentId"] == job["intentId"] && receipt["sourceSha256"] == job["sourceSha256"] &&
        receipt["directory"] == File.join(path,"received"), "RUBY_BUSINESS_RECEIPT_CHANGED")
      Files.need(expected_manifest_sha256.nil? || receipt["manifestSha256"] == expected_manifest_sha256,
        "RUBY_DELIVERY_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
      delivery = Delivery.open(receipt["directory"],expected_manifest_sha256: receipt.fetch("manifestSha256"))
      Files.need(delivery.manifest["intentId"] == job["intentId"] &&
        delivery.manifest["sourceSha256"] == job["sourceSha256"], "RUBY_BUSINESS_DELIVERY_CHANGED")
      delivery
    end

    def initialize(client:, buyer:, directory:, key:, bound:, response_file: nil)
      Files.need(client.is_a?(SellerClient) && buyer.is_a?(Buyer) && bound.is_a?(BoundRequest),
        "RUBY_BUSINESS_SOURCE_REQUIRED")
      @client, @buyer, @key = client, buyer, key.dup.freeze
      @root = Files.directory(directory,create: true)
      @directory = Files.directory(File.join(@root,self.class.key_id(key)),create: true)
      @intent_id = self.class.intent_id(key)
      Files.need(bound.intent_id == @intent_id && bound.source_sha256 == client.source["sourceSha256"],
        "RUBY_BUSINESS_INTENT_CHANGED")
      Files.need(response_file.nil? || response_file.is_a?(Hash), "RUBY_RESPONSE_OPTIONS_REQUIRED")
      @response_file = response_file.nil? ? nil : Files.parse(Files.json(Files.values!(response_file)))
      @bound = bound
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        bound.save(File.join(@directory,"request"))
        plan = Files.read(File.join(@directory,"request","request-plan.json"),131_072)
        job = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-business-job.v1","keySha256"=>self.class.key_id(key),
          "intentId"=>@intent_id,"buyerDirectory"=>buyer.directory,"sourceSha256"=>bound.source_sha256,
          "rubyManifestSha256"=>client.manifest_sha256,"requestPlanSha256"=>Files.hash(plan),
          "requestSha256"=>Files.hash(bound.record_bytes),"responseFile"=>@response_file}
        @job_bytes = Files.json(job).freeze
        @job_sha = Files.hash(@job_bytes)
        Files.once(File.join(@directory,"job.json"),@job_bytes)
      end
    end

    def bound
      @client.load_request(File.join(@directory,"request"))
    end
    def operation
      Operation.new(@buyer,@intent_id,@bound.source_sha256)
    end
    def same_job!
      Files.need(Files.read(File.join(@directory,"job.json"),131_072) == @job_bytes,
        "RUBY_BUSINESS_JOB_CHANGED")
    end
    def complete?
      File.file?(File.join(@directory,"received.json"))
    end
    def delivery
      self.class.received(directory: @root,key: @key)
    end

    # Repeating preparation adopts the exact existing native operation. The
    # original native intent and bound request, not a transport UUID, own it.
    def prepare(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        prepare_inside(cancel: cancel)
      end
    end
    def prepare_inside(cancel: nil)
      path = File.join(@directory,"prepared.json")
      if File.exist?(path)
        saved = Files.parse(Files.read(path,131_072))
        Files.need(saved["jobSha256"] == @job_sha && saved["intentId"] == @intent_id,
          "RUBY_BUSINESS_PREPARATION_CHANGED")
        return operation
      end
      selected = bound
      prepared = @client.prepare(@buyer,selected,response_file: @response_file,cancel: cancel)
      Files.once(path,Files.json({"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-business-prepared.v1",
        "jobSha256"=>@job_sha,"intentId"=>@intent_id}))
      prepared
    end
    private :prepare_inside

    def review(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        selected = prepare_inside(cancel: cancel)
        path = File.join(@directory,"review.json")
        if File.exist?(path)
          saved = Files.parse(Files.read(path))
          Files.need(saved["intentId"] == @intent_id, "RUBY_BUSINESS_REVIEW_CHANGED")
          return saved
        end
        value = selected.review(cancel: cancel)
        Files.once(path,Files.json(value))
        value
      end
    end

    # Call only from the explicit operator action. A worker retry uses recover
    # and receive; it never grants a new paid attempt.
    def execute(review:, cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        review_bytes = Files.read(File.join(@directory,"review.json"))
        Files.need(Files.parse(review_bytes) == review && review["intentId"] == @intent_id,
          "RUBY_BUSINESS_REVIEW_CHANGED")
        path = File.join(@directory,"execution.json")
        plan = if File.exist?(path)
          Files.parse(Files.read(path,131_072))
        else
          value = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-business-execution.v1",
            "jobSha256"=>@job_sha,"intentId"=>@intent_id,"reviewSha256"=>Files.hash(review_bytes),
            "callId"=>SecureRandom.uuid}
          Files.once(path,Files.json(value))
          value
        end
        Files.need(plan["jobSha256"] == @job_sha && plan["intentId"] == @intent_id &&
          plan["reviewSha256"] == Files.hash(review_bytes) && CALL_ID.match?(plan["callId"] || ""),
          "RUBY_BUSINESS_EXECUTION_CHANGED")
        begin
          operation.execute(review: review,call_id: plan["callId"],cancel: cancel)
        rescue Error => cause
          # Reading an original result is safe after a lost native reply. A null
          # recovery preserves the actual original error for the operator.
          recovered = operation.recover(cancel: cancel) unless cancel&.cancelled?
          raise cause if recovered.nil?
          recovered
        end
      end
    end

    def recover(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        operation.recover(cancel: cancel)
      end
    end
    def status(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        return {"state"=>"RECEIVED","intentId"=>@intent_id,"delivery"=>delivery.manifest} if complete?
        {"state"=>File.exist?(File.join(@directory,"execution.json")) ? "ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT" :
          File.exist?(File.join(@directory,"prepared.json")) ? "PREPARED" : "REQUEST_RETAINED",
          "intentId"=>@intent_id,"operation"=>File.exist?(File.join(@directory,"prepared.json")) ?
            operation.status(cancel: cancel) : nil}
      end
    end

    def receive(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        return delivery if complete?
        result = operation.recover(cancel: cancel)
        Files.need(result && result.dig("delivery","status") == "SAVED", "RUBY_ORIGINAL_RESPONSE_REQUIRED")
        received = operation.receive(File.join(@directory,"received"),cancel: cancel)
        Files.once(File.join(@directory,"received.json"),Files.json({
          "schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-business-received.v1","jobSha256"=>@job_sha,
          "intentId"=>@intent_id,"sourceSha256"=>@bound.source_sha256,
          "directory"=>received.directory,"manifestSha256"=>received.manifest_sha256}))
        received
      end
    end
  end
end

"""Privileged original SF36 settlement worker. No signer or payment retry.

The trusted buyer host supplies its private original SF81/SF82 capture. The
worker checks the complete approved request against the existing HMAC ledger,
invokes original SF86 against Stellar RPC, then calls original reconcile().
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import signal
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading

from governor import Denied, Governor, canonical, issue_finality_attestation, validate_request

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'sf62-human-approval-cli'))
from console import check_ledger_path, key_from_environment  # noqa: E402

SCHEMA = 'stellar-forge.sf36.finalization.v1'
HASH = re.compile(r'^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
ADAPTER = Path(__file__).with_name('observe.mjs')
MAX_SOURCE = 4_000_000
# The original JS signer and observer read this same maintained source catalog.
NETWORKS = json.loads((ROOT / 'sf86-rpc-transfer-reconcile' / 'networks.json').read_text())
DEFAULT_RPC = NETWORKS['stellar:testnet']['defaultRpc']
RPC_ENDPOINTS = tuple(endpoint for profile in NETWORKS.values() for endpoint in profile['rpcEndpoints'])


def unique_object(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in result:
            raise Denied('DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY')
        result[key] = value
    return result


def decode(raw: bytes):
    def nonfinite(_):
        raise Denied('NONFINITE_JSON')
    result = json.loads(raw.decode('utf8'), object_pairs_hook=unique_object,
                        parse_constant=nonfinite)
    if type(result) is not dict:
        raise Denied('JSON_OBJECT_REQUIRED')
    return result


def private_path(path: Path, *, directory=False):
    if not path.is_absolute() or path.resolve() != path:
        raise Denied('ABSOLUTE_NORMALIZED_PATH_WITHOUT_SYMLINK_REQUIRED')
    info = path.lstat()
    if (not (stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) if directory else stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode))
            or info.st_uid != os.geteuid() or info.st_mode & 0o077):
        raise Denied('PRIVATE_OPERATOR_OWNED_SOURCE_REQUIRED')
    # The original protected host capture supplies HTTP-intent/transaction
    # association. It must not be replaceable through a shared-writable parent.
    if path.parent.stat().st_mode & (stat.S_IWGRP | stat.S_IWOTH):
        raise Denied('SOURCE_PARENT_SHARED_WRITABLE')


def read_source(path: Path, *, private=True):
    if private:
        private_path(path)
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'rb') as stream:
        info = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_size > MAX_SOURCE:
            raise Denied('SOURCE_MISSING_OR_TOO_LARGE')
        raw = stream.read(MAX_SOURCE + 1)
    if len(raw) > MAX_SOURCE:
        raise Denied('SOURCE_TOO_LARGE')
    return decode(raw)


def original_record(source):
    if source.get('schema') == 'scf82.checkout-evidence.v1':
        saved = source.get('reconciliation', {})
        record = saved.get('record')
        if saved.get('status') != 'AVAILABLE' or type(record) is not dict:
            raise Denied('ORIGINAL_RECONCILIATION_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE')
        if source.get('intentId') != record.get('intentId'):
            raise Denied('ORIGINAL_EVIDENCE_INTENT_MISMATCH')
        return record
    return source


def approved_record(source):
    record = original_record(source)
    p = record.get('operatorReservation')
    if type(p) is not dict or p.get('schema') != 'stellar-forge.sf62.result.v1' or \
            p.get('outcome') != 'FRESH_RESERVATION_APPROVED':
        raise Denied('ORIGINAL_OPERATOR_RESERVATION_REQUIRED')
    request = validate_request(p.get('approved_request'))
    request_sha = hashlib.sha256(canonical(request)).hexdigest()
    if type(p.get('request_sha256')) is not str or not hmac.compare_digest(request_sha, p['request_sha256']):
        raise Denied('APPROVED_REQUEST_DIGEST_MISMATCH')
    q, receipt = record.get('requirement'), record.get('receipt')
    if type(q) is not dict or type(receipt) is not dict:
        raise Denied('ORIGINAL_NATIVE_TERMS_AND_RECEIPT_REQUIRED')
    if request['scheme'] != 'exact' or request['network'] not in NETWORKS:
        raise Denied('ORIGINAL_RPC_EXACT_STELLAR_REQUIRED')
    if record.get('intentId') != request['request_id'] or p.get('request_id') != request['request_id']:
        raise Denied('ORIGINAL_RESERVATION_ID_MISMATCH')
    if any(q.get(key) != request[field] for key, field in (
            ('scheme', 'scheme'), ('network', 'network'), ('asset', 'asset'),
            ('payTo', 'pay_to'), ('amount', 'max_amount'))) or \
            any(p.get(key) != request[field] for key, field in (
                ('network', 'network'), ('asset', 'asset'), ('reserved_atomic_units', 'max_amount'))):
        raise Denied('APPROVED_PAYMENT_TERMS_MISMATCH')
    if receipt.get('network') != request['network'] or \
            not isinstance(receipt.get('transaction'), str) or not HASH.fullmatch(receipt['transaction']):
        raise Denied('ORIGINAL_TRANSACTION_REQUIRED')
    return record, request, request_sha


def run_adapter(node: str, payload: dict, *, use_system_ca=False):
    # The operator config chooses an executable, not a shell or arbitrary module.
    # SF36 keys and unrelated credentials never enter the Node observer process.
    if type(use_system_ca) is not bool:
        raise Denied('INVALID_OBSERVER_SYSTEM_CA_OPTION')
    arguments = [node, *(['--use-system-ca'] if use_system_ca else []), str(ADAPTER)]
    result = subprocess.run(arguments, input=canonical(payload),
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        env={'LANG': 'C.UTF-8', 'LC_ALL': 'C.UTF-8'}, timeout=420, check=False)
    if len(result.stdout) > MAX_SOURCE:
        raise Denied('ORIGINAL_OBSERVER_RESULT_TOO_LARGE')
    parsed = decode(result.stdout)
    if result.returncode or parsed.get('error'):
        raise Denied('ORIGINAL_OBSERVER_FAILED')
    return parsed


def verified_facts(proof, request, request_sha, transaction, payer):
    profile = NETWORKS[request['network']]
    if type(proof) is not dict or proof.get('schema') != 'stellar-forge.sf86.rpc-reconciliation.v1' or \
            proof.get('verdict') != profile['transferVerdict'] or \
            proof.get('source') != profile['rpcSource'] or \
            proof.get('rpcEndpoint') not in profile['rpcEndpoints'] or \
            proof.get('networkPassphrase') != profile['passphrase']:
        raise Denied('FRESH_ORIGINAL_RPC_MATCH_REQUIRED')
    expected = {'intentId': request['request_id'], 'transaction': transaction,
        'network': request['network'], 'asset': request['asset'], 'payer': payer,
        'recipient': request['pay_to'], 'atomicAmount': request['max_amount']}
    if any(proof.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()) or \
            proof.get('matchingTransfers') != 1 or type(proof.get('ledger')) is not int or proof['ledger'] < 1 or \
            type(proof.get('matchingEventId')) is not str or not (1 <= len(proof['matchingEventId']) <= 512):
        raise Denied('RPC_FACTS_DO_NOT_MATCH_ORIGINAL_APPROVAL')
    # RPC latestLedger, pagination and response hashes change after finality.
    # Hash immutable, independently verified facts for idempotent accounting.
    return {'schema': 'stellar-forge.sf36.verified-facts.v1', **expected,
        'request_sha256': request_sha, 'ledger': proof['ledger'],
        'eventId': proof['matchingEventId']}


def finalize_source(governor, source, payer, *, node, rpc_endpoint=None,
                    expected_request_sha=None, rpc_proxy_url=None, use_system_ca=False):
    record, request, request_sha = approved_record(source)
    profile = NETWORKS[request['network']]
    rpc_endpoint = rpc_endpoint or profile['defaultRpc']
    if rpc_endpoint not in profile['rpcEndpoints']:
        raise Denied('RPC_ENDPOINT_NOT_ALLOWED')
    if expected_request_sha is not None and not hmac.compare_digest(request_sha, expected_request_sha):
        raise Denied('SELECTED_INBOX_REQUEST_DIGEST_MISMATCH')
    row = governor.reservation(request)
    receipt = record['receipt']
    if receipt.get('payer') != payer:
        raise Denied('TRUSTED_PAYER_DOES_NOT_MATCH_ORIGINAL_RECEIPT')
    # One canonical receipt string keeps the original governor's network-level
    # receipt reuse protection effective across different request IDs.
    receipt_ref = request['network'] + '/' + receipt['transaction']
    if row['state'] == 'settled':
        if row['receipt_ref'] != receipt_ref or row['actual'] != request['max_amount']:
            raise Denied('EXISTING_FINALITY_CONFLICT')
        return {'schema': SCHEMA, 'outcome': 'IDEMPOTENT_FINALIZED',
            'request_id': request['request_id'], 'actual': row['actual'],
            'request_sha256': request_sha,
            'receipt_ref': receipt_ref, 'proof_sha256': row['proof_sha256'],
            'chainObservation': 'ORIGINAL_AUDITED_FINALIZATION_REUSED'}
    proof = run_adapter(node, {'action': 'observe', 'source': source, 'payer': payer,
                              'rpcEndpoint': rpc_endpoint,
                              **({'rpcProxyUrl': rpc_proxy_url} if rpc_proxy_url is not None else {})},
                        use_system_ca=use_system_ca)
    facts = verified_facts(proof, request, request_sha, receipt['transaction'], payer)
    # Audit again after network IO, before issuing authority. Original reconcile
    # then takes its own immediate transaction and rechecks journal/projection.
    governor.reservation(request)
    proof_sha = hashlib.sha256(canonical(facts)).hexdigest()
    attestation = issue_finality_attestation(governor.ok, request['request_id'],
        request['max_amount'], receipt_ref, proof_sha)
    result = governor.reconcile(attestation)
    return {'schema': SCHEMA, **result, 'receipt_ref': receipt_ref,
        'request_sha256': request_sha,
        'proof_sha256': proof_sha, 'verifiedFacts': facts,
        'chainObservation': 'FRESH_ORIGINAL_SF86_RPC'}


def write_report(directory: Path, source: Path, result):
    # The report is restartable output. Only original SF36 is accounting state.
    name = hashlib.sha256(str(source).encode('utf8')).hexdigest() + '.json'
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.finalize-', dir=directory)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as stream:
            stream.write(canonical(result) + b'\n')
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary, directory / name)
        parent = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
        try:
            os.fsync(parent)
        finally:
            os.close(parent)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sources = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    sources.add_argument('--record', type=Path, help='Private original SF81 record or SF82 evidence')
    sources.add_argument('--records-dir', type=Path, help='Private existing original evidence directory')
    sources.add_argument('--manual-source', type=Path, help='Private original SF88 missing-receipt selection descriptor')
    sources.add_argument('--lost-output-source', type=Path, help='Private original SF88 lost-output selection and exact approved-request preimage')
    sources.add_argument('--lost-output-dataset-source', type=Path, help='Private original SF88 Dataset page lost-output selection and exact approved request')
    sources.add_argument('--node-reservation-source', type=Path, help='Read-only original Node attempt and HMAC reservation inspection')
    parser.add_argument('--verify-only', action='store_true', help='Authenticate existing selected recovery without provider IO or writes')
    parser.add_argument('--ledger', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--policy', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--payer', required=True, help='Actual account from trusted signer configuration')
    parser.add_argument('--node', default=shutil.which('node'))
    parser.add_argument('--node-use-system-ca', action='store_true',
                        help='Explicitly use the installed system CA store in the isolated Node observer')
    parser.add_argument('--rpc-endpoint', choices=RPC_ENDPOINTS,
                        help='Public RPC for the original approved network; defaults per record')
    parser.add_argument('--rpc-proxy-env', help='Explicit environment variable containing a credential-free HTTP CONNECT proxy URL')
    parser.add_argument('--expected-request-sha', help='Selected inbox approval digest, when called from SF88')
    parser.add_argument('--reports', type=Path, required=True, help='Separate existing private output directory')
    parser.add_argument('--outbox', type=Path, help='Existing original merchant SF98 private outbox')
    parser.add_argument('--merchant-route', help='Independently selected original seller route ID')
    parser.add_argument('--watch-seconds', type=int, default=0, help='0: one sweep; >=30: repeat read-only observation')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    stop = threading.Event()
    try:
        if not args.node or not Path(args.node).is_absolute() or not Path(args.node).is_file() or not os.access(args.node, os.X_OK):
            raise Denied('TRUSTED_ABSOLUTE_NODE_EXECUTABLE_REQUIRED')
        if not re.fullmatch(r'G[A-Z2-7]{55}', args.payer):
            raise Denied('TRUSTED_CLASSIC_PAYER_REQUIRED')
        if args.expected_request_sha is not None and (not (args.record or args.manual_source or args.lost_output_source or args.lost_output_dataset_source or args.node_reservation_source) or
                not HASH.fullmatch(args.expected_request_sha)):
            raise Denied('EXPECTED_DIGEST_REQUIRES_ONE_ORIGINAL_RECORD')
        selected_recovery = args.manual_source or args.lost_output_source or args.lost_output_dataset_source or args.node_reservation_source
        if args.node_reservation_source and (not args.verify_only or args.rpc_endpoint or args.rpc_proxy_env):
            raise Denied('NODE_RESERVATION_READ_ONLY_MODE_REQUIRED')
        if args.verify_only and not selected_recovery or selected_recovery and (
                not args.expected_request_sha or args.watch_seconds or args.outbox or args.merchant_route):
            raise Denied('LOST_OUTPUT_RECOVERY_REQUIRES_ONE_EXPLICIT_SELECTION' if (args.lost_output_source or args.lost_output_dataset_source)
                         else 'MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRES_ONE_EXPLICIT_SELECTION')
        if args.watch_seconds and args.watch_seconds < 30:
            raise Denied('WATCH_INTERVAL_MUST_BE_AT_LEAST_30_SECONDS')
        rpc_proxy_url = None
        if args.rpc_proxy_env is not None:
            if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}', args.rpc_proxy_env):
                raise Denied('INVALID_PROXY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME')
            rpc_proxy_url = os.environ.get(args.rpc_proxy_env)
            if not isinstance(rpc_proxy_url, str) or not rpc_proxy_url or len(rpc_proxy_url) > 4096:
                raise Denied('EXPLICIT_RPC_PROXY_ENVIRONMENT_REQUIRED')
            # The fixed original Node observer validates this with SF31/SF85
            # before connecting. It travels only through that private JSON pipe;
            # no operator keys or unrelated environment enter the observer.
        check_ledger_path(args.ledger)
        private_path(args.ledger)  # MUST exist; Governor must not create a new ledger.
        private_path(args.reports, directory=True)
        if args.record and args.record.parent == args.reports:
            raise Denied('REPORTS_MUST_BE_SEPARATE_FROM_ORIGINAL_EVIDENCE')
        if args.records_dir:
            private_path(args.records_dir, directory=True)
            if args.records_dir == args.reports:
                raise Denied('REPORTS_MUST_BE_SEPARATE_FROM_ORIGINAL_EVIDENCE')
        if bool(args.outbox) != bool(args.merchant_route):
            raise Denied('OUTBOX_AND_ORIGINAL_MERCHANT_ROUTE_REQUIRED_TOGETHER')
        if args.outbox:
            private_path(args.outbox, directory=True)
            if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}', args.merchant_route):
                raise Denied('INVALID_ORIGINAL_MERCHANT_ROUTE')
            for name in ('events.ndjson', 'deliveries.ndjson'):
                path = args.outbox / name
                if path.exists():
                    private_path(path)
        policy = read_source(args.policy, private=False)
        keys = [key_from_environment('SF36_' + name + '_KEY_B64')
                for name in ('CONSENT', 'AUDIT', 'OPERATOR')]
        os.umask(0o077)
        governor = Governor(args.ledger, policy, *keys)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, lambda *_: stop.set())
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, lambda *_: stop.set())
        try:
            while not stop.is_set():
                selected_source = args.node_reservation_source or args.lost_output_dataset_source or args.lost_output_source or args.manual_source or args.record
                paths = [selected_source] if selected_source else sorted(args.records_dir.glob('*.json'))
                failed = 0
                for path in paths:
                    if stop.is_set():
                        break
                    try:
                        source = read_source(path)
                        if args.node_reservation_source:
                            from lost_node_finality import inspect_node_reservation
                            result = inspect_node_reservation(governor, path, source, args.payer, node=args.node,
                                ledger=args.ledger, policy=args.policy, expected_request_sha=args.expected_request_sha,
                                use_system_ca=args.node_use_system_ca)
                        elif args.lost_output_dataset_source:
                            from lost_dataset_finality import finalize_dataset_lost_output
                            result = finalize_dataset_lost_output(governor, path, source, args.payer, node=args.node,
                                ledger=args.ledger, policy=args.policy, rpc_endpoint=args.rpc_endpoint,
                                expected_request_sha=args.expected_request_sha, rpc_proxy_url=rpc_proxy_url,
                                verify_only=args.verify_only, use_system_ca=args.node_use_system_ca)
                        elif args.lost_output_source:
                            from lost_output_finality import finalize_lost_output
                            result = finalize_lost_output(governor, path, source, args.payer, node=args.node,
                                ledger=args.ledger, policy=args.policy, rpc_endpoint=args.rpc_endpoint,
                                expected_request_sha=args.expected_request_sha, rpc_proxy_url=rpc_proxy_url,
                                verify_only=args.verify_only, use_system_ca=args.node_use_system_ca)
                        elif args.manual_source:
                            from manual_finality import finalize_manual
                            result = finalize_manual(governor, path, source, args.payer, node=args.node,
                                ledger=args.ledger, policy=args.policy, rpc_endpoint=args.rpc_endpoint,
                                expected_request_sha=args.expected_request_sha, rpc_proxy_url=rpc_proxy_url,
                                verify_only=args.verify_only, use_system_ca=args.node_use_system_ca)
                        else:
                            result = finalize_source(governor, source, args.payer, node=args.node,
                                rpc_endpoint=args.rpc_endpoint, expected_request_sha=args.expected_request_sha,
                                rpc_proxy_url=rpc_proxy_url, use_system_ca=args.node_use_system_ca)
                        result['merchant'] = {'status': 'NOT_CONFIGURED'}
                        if args.outbox:
                            try:
                                result['merchant'] = run_adapter(args.node, {'action': 'merchant',
                                    'source': source, 'outbox': str(args.outbox), 'route': args.merchant_route},
                                    use_system_ca=args.node_use_system_ca)
                            except (Denied, OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
                                result['merchant'] = {'status': 'ORIGINAL_MERCHANT_JOURNAL_READ_FAILED'}
                    except (Denied, OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
                        failed += 1
                        result = {'schema': SCHEMA, 'outcome': 'NOT_FINALIZED',
                            'reason': str(error) if isinstance(error, Denied) else 'SOURCE_OR_OBSERVER_IO_FAILED',
                            'reservation': 'UNCHANGED_BY_THIS_ATTEMPT'}
                    if not args.verify_only:
                        write_report(args.reports, path, result)
                    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True), flush=True)
                if not args.watch_seconds:
                    return 2 if failed else 0
                stop.wait(args.watch_seconds)
        finally:
            governor.close()
        return 0
    except (Denied, OSError, ValueError, TypeError) as error:
        print(json.dumps({'schema': SCHEMA, 'outcome': 'WORKER_ERROR',
            'reason': str(error) if isinstance(error, Denied) else 'OPERATOR_IO_OR_CONFIGURATION_ERROR',
            'accounting': 'INSPECT_ORIGINAL_LEDGER_REPORT_WRITE_MAY_HAVE_FOLLOWED_FINALIZATION'}))
        return 2


if __name__ == '__main__':
    # console.py may add the real source tree to sys.path while this worker is
    # running from an explicit source overlay. Recovery companions must import
    # this executing worker and its fixed observer, rather than another copy.
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
    sys.modules['finalize'] = sys.modules[__name__]
    raise SystemExit(main())
